pluss::note::empty¶

Back to Note Factory API Reference

Signatures¶

Note pluss::note::empty(integer_range sizes)

A Shape Pre-Filled With The Empty String¶

empty() allocates a Note of shape sizes with every cell holding "". It is defined as full(sizes, "") and shares that function’s contract exactly — only the fill value is fixed.

Unlike numeric empty factories in some libraries, this one does not leave cells uninitialised: text cells have no meaningful “uninitialised” state, so every cell is a real, valid empty string. The name follows the series/timeline family for consistency; read it as “empty contents, known shape”, not “empty of cells”.

Use it to stage a block you will fill in afterwards — a results grid whose rows are computed one at a time, a fixed-width table you will populate column by column, a scratch buffer of the right geometry. Because every cell already satisfies the “is text” contract, the Note is immediately usable with every Note method; unwritten cells simply read as "".

sizes follows the same rules as full: any contiguous range of std::int64_t, an empty range for a scalar, non-negative extents, zero extents allowed, rank at most three, validated before allocation. The result is UTF-8 mode.

empty versus a zero-length Note¶

These are different things:

  • empty({2, 2}) — four cells, each "".

  • full({0}, "x") — a rank-1 Note with no cells.

empty never removes cells; it only chooses their starting value.

Example 1: A Matrix Of Empty Strings¶

std::array<std::int64_t, 2> sizes{2, 2};
const pluss::Note n = pluss::note::empty(
    pluss::msharp::RangeView::Of<std::int64_t>(sizes));
std::cout << pluss::note::print(n) << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[2, 2], dim=2, numel=4, encoding=utf8)
[
  ["", ""], 
  ["", ""]
]

Four addressable cells, all "", ready to be overwritten.

Example 2: A Scalar Empty String¶

std::array<std::int64_t, 0> sizes{};
const pluss::Note n = pluss::note::empty(
    pluss::msharp::RangeView::Of<std::int64_t>(sizes));
std::cout << n << "\n";

Output¶

Note(shape=[], dim=0, numel=1, encoding=utf8)
""

The same value pluss::note::make("") builds, reached shape-first.
